fieldNotes.location: Building G8, 7th Street, Freeport Center, Clearfield UT 84016 - positively confirmed. Roster ROOFTOP geocode (41.100339,-112.035023) matches the Google geocode for 'G-8, 7th St' exactly, and Street View shows a 'G-8 7th Street' sign on the building. Freeport Center is a 680-acre former WWII military depot with 78 long warehouse buildings on an internal street grid; Kenco occupies building G8 (~90,000 SF, food grade).
fieldNotes.buildingLayout: G8 is one long, narrow Freeport Center warehouse (~230 m x 35 m) running NW-SE. Per Freeport Center's published description, most buildings have a railroad loading dock on one side and a truck loading dock on the other.
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE. Individual Freeport buildings have no truck gate of their own - trucks pull directly off the internal Freeport streets and back into the comb-shaped dock canopy. No barrier arm, gate, or guard booth at building G8. (Note: the overall Freeport Center complex may have perimeter control, but G8 itself has none.)
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No staffed booth at the building.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Truck docks are under a comb-shaped canopy along one long side; estimated ~16 truck dock doors for a building this size. Band 10-25. Low-confidence count - the canopy obscures exact door count from overhead.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: TRUE (Freeport-pattern) - rail dock on one long side, truck dock on the opposite long side, so inbound rail receiving and outbound truck shipping run from physically separate building faces. Flagged - inferred from the Freeport Center standard layout rather than directly counted.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a few trailers park along the street frontage; no dedicated per-building drop lot. Band 0-10.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Trucks back into the comb dock directly from the narrow internal street - the approach holds only 1-2 trucks.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: TRUE - a backing truck occupies the narrow internal Freeport street; a queue would block the shared street and adjacent buildings' access.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE - G8 sits within the 78-building Freeport Center campus; many large building clusters share the property.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE - rail spurs run through the Freeport Center streets and along the building rows; G8 has a rail dock per the Freeport standard layout.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Clearfield/Ogden metro and the dense Freeport Center industrial complex - Urban.
